Hi @eng-74, the design review notes for installment_schedule are in my handover file at notes/eng-47/handover.md. The key decision is: the schedule is anchored to first_due, so installment k is due on due_date(first_due, k * interval_days). A weekend shift for one installment must NOT chain to later installments (each is computed independently from first_due). Hope that helps!
